description: CapMeta catalog tool (no Linode API call). Pins the success path both languages must project identically: a narrow category filter with its rows, and a filter matching nothing so the empty envelope stays {count, tools: []} rather than a null list. The rows move when the core category's membership moves, which is the point: a surface change that lands in one language only fails here.

cases.name: answers the core category with capability and category tags
answers an empty envelope for a category no tool carries
